recall_checks.title: AdaParse: An Adaptive Parallel PDF Parsing and Resource Scaling Engine
recall_checks.basis: Complete original input Abstract plus official Abstract read: AdaParse performs generic scientific-PDF parser selection, human preference DPO and throughput scheduling. It prepares generic text corpora; no direct contribution to a specified scientific research question beyond general parsing software.

recall_checks.title: Know Where You’re Uncertain When Planning with Multimodal Foundation Models: A Formal Framework
recall_checks.basis: Initial keyword-screening miss recovered from complete61-paper proceedings. Actual multimodal-model robotic perception and planning are studied, with conformal calibration separating perception/decision uncertainty, formal verification, active sensing and model refinement, tested in real-world and simulated robot tasks. This directly contributes to concrete autonomous-system reliability and control engineering rather than only generic model throughput.
